name: glove_planar_poses_recording_set
description: Set D: 10 static single-plane poses for the XR glove, gloves on, no camera, each held still; written by scripts/leap/glove_planar_poses.py, ranges and exclusions in protocols/glove_planar_poses_50.csv. Record with scripts/glove/record_poses.py --pose-list this file.
setup: gloves on, no camera: XR Train open and streaming, the hand held still in the pose for the 5 s of the take
plane: each digit moves only in its own flexion-extension plane: fingers side by side (spread together), wrist neutral, thumb bent or straight in its own plane

items.label: middle tip curl, others straight
items.shape: only the middle finger with PIP and DIP half bent and its MCP straight; the other three straight and together, thumb straight in the palm plane
items.orientation: gloves on, no camera; move each digit only in its own bending plane, fingers side by side, wrist straight

items.label: middle and ring tabletop
items.shape: middle and ring bent 90 at the MCP only, index and little straight, thumb up in plane
items.orientation: gloves on, no camera; move each digit only in its own bending plane, fingers side by side, wrist straight

items.label: little straight, three hooked
items.shape: index, middle and ring bent at PIP and DIP with MCP straight, little straight
items.orientation: gloves on, no camera; move each digit only in its own bending plane, fingers side by side, wrist straight

items.label: radial quarter, ulnar full
items.shape: index and middle a quarter curled, ring and little fully curled
items.orientation: gloves on, no camera; move each digit only in its own bending plane, fingers side by side, wrist straight

items.label: index full, middle half
items.shape: index fully curled, middle held half curled, ring and little straight
items.orientation: gloves on, no camera; move each digit only in its own bending plane, fingers side by side, wrist straight

items.label: ring full, little half
items.shape: ring fully curled, little held half curled, index and middle straight
items.orientation: gloves on, no camera; move each digit only in its own bending plane, fingers side by side, wrist straight

items.label: radial quarter, ulnar half
items.shape: index and middle a quarter curled, ring and little half curled
items.orientation: gloves on, no camera; move each digit only in its own bending plane, fingers side by side, wrist straight

items.label: radial tip curl, ulnar half, thumb tip bent
items.shape: index and middle with PIP and DIP half bent, ring and little half curled, thumb straight at its MCP with only the tip joint bent
items.orientation: gloves on, no camera; move each digit only in its own bending plane, fingers side by side, wrist straight

items.label: radial half, ulnar tip curl, thumb MCP bent
items.shape: index and middle half curled, ring and little with PIP and DIP half bent, thumb bent at its MCP only
items.orientation: gloves on, no camera; move each digit only in its own bending plane, fingers side by side, wrist straight

items.label: radial full, ulnar tabletop, thumb across
items.shape: index and middle fully curled, ring and little bent 90 at the MCP only, thumb half flexed across the palm
items.orientation: gloves on, no camera; move each digit only in its own bending plane, fingers side by side, wrist straight
